derivation: from a comparative of G5495 (χείρ) and (to stretch);
def: to be a hand-reacher or voter (by raising the hand), i.e. (generally) to select or appoint

occurrences.text: And when they had ordained them elders in every church, and had prayed with fasting, they commended them to the Lord, on whom they believed.
And not that only, but who was also chosen of the churches to travel with us with this grace, which is administered by us to the glory of the same Lord, and declaration of your ready mind:
